title: Code Petri Dish: simulator, instruments, pre-specified analysis scripts and results for 'When a stalled copy draws again'
description: Simulator (sim.js v0.3.6), instruments, launch and analysis scripts, frozen SHA-256 files, independent recounts and result files behind every number in the manuscript When a stalled copy draws again: copy-loop length couples replication speed to realised mutation rate under conserved material (MinSeo Kim and Jae-Ho Shin, 2026), together with the figure generator and its provenance list, and a patch adding the copying rules to Avida (LGPL-3.0-or-later). The rendered figure files are not deposited, so that the figures of the article are published by the journal alone; the generator reproduces them from the result files. Backgrounds are grown deterministically from their seeds by the scripts provided.
